thesis.core: AI server, rack and high-speed networking demand is producing a genuine earnings step-up. 2026H1 revenue and attributable profit reached record levels, so the underwriting question is no longer whether the AI demand inflection exists, but whether margin quality and cash conversion can remain strong enough to justify a premium multiple after the rerating.
thesis.variant_wedge: The company is still partly valued through a low-margin EMS lens while AI infrastructure mix is lifting profit faster than revenue. At the same time, current valuation already discounts substantial continuation of AI growth, so additional capital requires a real expected-return margin of safety rather than buying simply because the share price is below historical cost.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use RMB3.15 2026E normalized EPS as the base, close to the latest post-H1 estimate and modestly above the 23-institution consensus of RMB3.10. This recognizes the record H1 earnings inflection without mechanically annualizing the near-doubling of H1 profit.

financial_quality.judgment: Earnings quality has improved materially with the AI mix, but cash conversion remains the principal quality watch because H1 operating cash flow still trails accounting profit despite the sharp year-on-year improvement.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: The base uses a modest post-H1 earnings upgrade while avoiding mechanical extrapolation of H1 growth.

catalysts: Cloud-service-provider AI server revenue and GPU/ASIC rack shipments remain on a high-growth trajectory through H2.
Higher-value AI server and high-speed networking mix sustains profit growth above revenue growth.
Operating cash conversion and free cash flow improve relative to net profit without disproportionate working-capital absorption.
kill_thesis: AI server or rack shipment growth decelerates sharply because customer capex weakens, technology transitions disrupt delivery, or market share is lost.
Gross or net margin reverses despite continued revenue growth, showing the mix upgrade is not durable.
Working capital and capex persistently absorb cash such that free-cash-flow growth materially lags earnings.
Customer concentration, export controls or geopolitical supply-chain disruption materially impair delivery or economics.

d2_answers.question: Is the earnings inflection fundamental?
d2_answers.fact: 2026H1 revenue rose 54.63% and attributable profit 95.99%; cloud AI-server and rack shipments showed multi-fold growth in disclosed operating data.

d2_answers.question: What does the current price discount?
Portfolio action?
d2_answers.judgment: HOLD the existing simulation position. The greater-than-15% unrealized drawdown is not itself a sell or add signal; reassess ADD only around RMB63.46 or lower if the operating thesis remains intact.
